title: oxytropis lambertii subsp. bigelovii
intro: Oxytropis lambertii subsp. bigelovii, commonly known as Bigelow's globemallow, is a perennial plant that belongs to the legume family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bigelow's globemallow include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
